title: Vectors
notes: **Scalar:** magnitude only (mass, speed, work, temperature). **Vector:** magnitude + direction (displacement, velocity, force, momentum).
**Triangle law / Parallelogram law:** resultant R of two vectors P and Q inclined at angle θ: R² = P² + Q² + 2PQ cos θ, tan α = Q sin θ / (P + Q cos θ).
**Resolution:** a vector can be split into components along chosen axes: A_x = A cos θ, A_y = A sin θ.
**Scalar (dot) product:** A·B = AB cos θ = A_xB_x + A_yB_y + A_zB_z. Work is a dot product. Vectors perpendicular ⇒ dot product = 0.
**Vector (cross) product:** A×B = AB sin θ (direction by right-hand rule). Torque and angular momentum are cross products. Parallel vectors ⇒ cross product = 0.
